messages:
Keisha: pic drop — Axie the axolotl found a tiny paper party hat in the supply closet and somehow it fits. https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F44444/axie_hat.jpg :party_parrot:

Omar: instant aristocrat. are we officially hosting a tea party in the fish tank? :tea:

Sasha: HOW does a hat stay on underwater? science? magic? :thinking:

Keisha: it's just balanced on the suction-cup prop; I tied it with a loose loop to the rock. not glued, promise. vet-approved? :sweat_smile:

Theo: cutest amphibian monarch I've seen. poll: name options please — 1) Sir Wiggle  2) Topper  3) Axie (already half name)  4) Floaty McFloat

Omar: `/:one:` Sir Wiggle for the nobility

Sasha: `/:two:` Topper is classy

PollBot: Poll created: "Name Axie the hat-wearer" Options: Sir Wiggle / Topper / Axie / Floaty McFloat — Current: Sir Wiggle 1, Topper 1

FacilitiesBot: Reminder: office tanks require weekly water checks. please add Axie's tank to the chart if not already. :clipboard:

Keisha: added to the maintenance sheet and scheduled a water swap Friday after lunch. feeding schedule updated: `freeze-dried daphnia Mon/Wed/Fri` posted in the sheet.

Omar: video incoming — Axie performs a graceful wiggle and the hat rotates dramatically. certified mood booster. :sparkles:

Sasha: will knit a tiny flag for the tank that says "No Meetings" in Morse. optional add-on: tiny disco light? :triangular_flag_on_post:

Keisha: please no disco lights, the axolotl is low-key. :pleading_face: but flag yes. will accept all crafts. thanks team!
